name: Siemens MS43 (BMW M54)

read_methods.notes: OBD supports programming. The stock 512 KiB DS2 read omits part of the flash; a complete read over OBD needs a temporary RAM agent on recognised boot variants, otherwise open-case boot mode.

notes: Siemens DME for the BMW M54 (2.2 / 2.5 / 3.0). AM29F400BB flash: 64 KiB boot + 384 KiB program + 64 KiB calibration. ms4x.net describes three CRC16 plus two 32-bit additive checksums (fix the additive ones first); OpenTune has no MS4x checksum module yet (checksum null). The second K-line pin on X60004 is disputed between sources (31 vs 32).

bench.notes: Multi-source minimum: +12 V to X60001-7 and X60004-26, ground X60001-4. ms4x.net's bench recipe instead feeds X60001-1, -7 and -8, grounds X60001-4/5/6 and uses K-line X60001-3 (X60004-32 as fallback). Boot mode is board-level: the C167's pin 104 is grounded while powering up, then released (ms4x 'How to connect'); never write a 512 KiB OBD read back in boot mode - it erases the unit-specific bootloader keys.
bench.resistor_notes: K-line programming; CAN (X60004-36/37) is for development only per ms4x.

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

obd.notes: Programming works over OBD. The stock 512 KiB DS2 read omits a protected region, so it is not a complete original backup. BimmerStein documents a complete 512 KiB read through a temporary RAM agent on recognised MS43 boot variants; other units need open-case boot mode for a complete read.

bench.how: For closed-case K-line access, MS4X supplies +12 V to X60001-1, -7 and -8, grounds X60001-4, -5 and -6, and uses X60001-3 for diagnostics. Vehicle CAN is on X60004-36 (high) and X60004-37 (low). The K-line bench connection does not use CAN.

boot.reset_timing: Hold the input low at power-up. MS4X specifies releasing it after about 10 seconds, before reading or writing.
boot.notes: MS4X identifies the processor pin on the MS43 board for a complete flash backup. Infineon confirms the pin assignment and active-low bootstrap selection.

security.notes: MS4X documents limits on diagnostic reads and support for programming. It does not establish the security-access requirement for either operation. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
